# L.U.M.E

Step into the world of  **L.U.M.E** — a calm and immersive VR experience focused on exploration, atmosphere, and thoughtful interaction.

**L.U.M.E** is built around light puzzle-solving and discovery rather than speed or pressure. Each environment encourages you to slow down, observe, and experiment with the world around you.

# Light & Laser Puzzles

A core mechanic of **L.U.M.E** is **light manipulation.**
